summary: Iter72 quick-add sync — verified end-to-end. Backend 7/7 iter72 pytests PASS. Frontend flows: (A2) Ship-To QuickAdd from Trip Form → site auto-populates picker AND auto-selects — PASS. (B) Vehicle QuickAdd from Trip Form → new vehicle appears in trip picker AND on /vehicles master without refresh — PASS. (C) Supplier-vehicle QuickAdd → SupplierSection renders with correct supplier pre-selected — PASS when the supplier name fits in the top-2000 of /api/suppliers list. Discovered pre-existing backend list-cap bug in /api/suppliers (`to_list(2000)`) that, combined with 13.4k accumulated test suppliers in the demo tenant, silently drops newly-created suppliers whose name sorts alphabetically after position 2000, breaking Test C label lookup in the SearchableSelect (though form.supplier_id is set correctly). Also flagged a pre-existing test-bug in test_iter63 now exposed by iter72 dedup.

minor.issue: Hard cap `to_list(2000)` in routers/suppliers.py line 61. Sorted by name asc — newly-created suppliers alphabetically past top-2000 are missing from response. Real users rarely hit this, but combined with 13,488 accumulated test suppliers in the demo tenant it prevents the freshly-quick-added supplier from showing up in the Trip Form Supplier picker (label lookup fails; picker falls back to placeholder even though form.supplier_id is populated). Recommend either (a) raise cap to 20000 (parity with /api/vehicles + /api/customers), or (b) switch to paginated + server-side search.

Test uses `UNIQUE[:5]` which is the constant string 'IT63_'. Vehicle numbers therefore collide across runs. Iter72's new dedup returns the pre-existing vehicle (with the earlier run's supplier_id) — assertion fails. Fix: use full UNIQUE (or a fresh uuid) in vehicle_number. Not a functional regression, just test-data bleed exposed by iter72 dedup semantics.

integration_issues.flow: Trip Form → QuickAdd Supplier Vehicle → Supplier auto-populate
integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly hydrates vehicle.supplier_id + supplier_name; frontend correctly sets form.supplier_id + supplier_name; SupplierSection renders correctly. However, the SupplierSection SearchableSelect looks up the label in the parent's `suppliers` array (from useQuery(['suppliers']) → /api/suppliers). When the new supplier isn't returned in that list (see backend minor issue above), the picker silently shows the placeholder 'Select supplier…' instead of the supplier name. form.supplier_id is still set — the 'Supplier is mandatory' warning is hidden — but the visual is misleading. Reproduced deterministically by creating a supplier whose name sorts after top-2000 in the demo tenant.

action_items: Backend: bump /api/suppliers list cap from 2000 → 20000 (parity with /api/vehicles + /api/customers) OR switch to paginated + server-side search. Without this, freshly-quick-added suppliers can disappear from Trip Form dropdown when the tenant has >2000 suppliers.

Test hygiene (optional): fix test_iter63 test_supplier_id_link_preserved to use full UNIQUE (or fresh uuid) in vehicle_number so it doesn't collide with prior runs after iter72's idempotent-vehicle dedup.
Env hygiene: consider a periodic cleanup script for the demo tenant (13,488 supplier rows accumulated); not blocking but slows every /suppliers list call and masks the above cap.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/suppliers.py line 61 — inconsistent list cap (2000) vs vehicles/customers (20000). Fixed limit + implicit alphabetical sort silently drops rows.

QuickAddVehicle modal also uses `useQuery(['suppliers'])` inside the modal — hits the same 2000 cap when picking supplier from picker. New '+ New' Supplier button bypasses it, but the pre-existing list is truncated.
iter72 backend logic (dedup, supplier hydration, cross-tenant guard, own-vehicle supplier-field strip) is well-covered by 7 tests and behaves correctly.

test_C_failure_when_supplier_name_sorts_.reproduction: 1) Log in as demo. 2) Trip Form → Vehicle picker → + Add New Vehicle. 3) Type='Supplier'. 4) Click '+ New' supplier, name it 'ZzUnique_<ts>'. Save. 5) Save vehicle. 6) Observe SupplierSection: picker shows 'Select supplier…' instead of 'ZzUnique_<ts>'.
test_C_failure_when_supplier_name_sorts_.root_cause: GET /api/suppliers returns `.sort('name', 1).to_list(2000)`. Demo tenant has 13,488 supplier docs (accumulated test data). New supplier is created in DB (POST /api/suppliers returns 200 with id), but /api/suppliers refetch afterwards still returns only the first 2000 alphabetically — the 'Zz*' entry never appears in the frontend's suppliers cache. SupplierSection's SearchableSelect can't find the label for form.supplier_id → falls back to placeholder. form.supplier_id itself is set correctly (validated by absence of mandatory-supplier warning).
test_C_failure_when_supplier_name_sorts_.mitigation: Change `to_list(2000)` → `to_list(20000)` in /app/backend/routers/suppliers.py line 61 to match /api/vehicles (20000) and /api/customers (20000). Longer-term: add pagination + server-side name search for scalability.
